output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=0]
    if not cells: return g
    # If the colored bands run vertically (columns have differing colors), mark top edge;
    # otherwise the bands run horizontally, mark right edge.
    rs=[i for i,j in cells]; cs=[j for i,j in cells]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    horiz = all(g[i][j]==g[i][c0] for i in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1))
    if horiz:
        for i in range(h): g[i][w-1]=8
    else:
        for j in range(w): g[0][j]=8
    return g"}

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    # identify the nonzero bounding box and whether its stripes run horizontally or vertically
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=0]
    if not cells: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # horizontal bands: each occupied row is essentially uniform; mark right border
    horiz=True
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        vals=[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)]
        if any(v==0 for v in vals) or len(set(vals))!=1:
            horiz=False; break
    if horiz:
        for r in range(h): out[r][w-1]=8
    else:
        for c in range(w): out[0][c]=8
    return out"}

{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # striped bands: determine whether nonzero pattern varies by rows or columns
    nz=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=0]
    if not nz: return out
    rows=set(r for r,c in nz); cols=set(c for r,c in nz)
    # horizontal bands have broad occupied rows; vertical bands broad occupied columns
    row_score=sum(sum(grid[r][c]!=0 for c in range(w)) for r in range(h))
    col_score=sum(sum(grid[r][c]!=0 for r in range(h)) for c in range(w))
    if row_score >= col_score:
        for r in range(h): out[r][w-1]=8
    else:
        for c in range(w): out[0][c]=8
    return out"}
